newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai inaugurates gasoline additive plant.
newsitem.headline: Dubai inaugurates gasoline additive plant.

text.p: State-owned Dubai Natural Gas Co Ltd (Dugas) on Sunday officially inaugurated its 500,000 tonne per year MTBE plant.

The methyl tertiary-butyl ether plant at Dubai's Jebel Ali free trade zone is currently marketing its output of the environmentally friendly gasoline additive to North America, a Dugas statement released at the ceremony said.
"The complex, operating at its full capacity of 500,000 metric tonnes annually, is now responsible for 2.5 percent of worldwide MTBE production," the statement said.
Dugas's MTBE plant is the first such facility in the United Arab Emirates and the fourth in the Gulf, joining three other MTBE plants in Saudi Arabia.
Production at the Jebel Ali plant, which runs off butane and methanol, began in February 1995.
"The tanker journey to North America takes 30 days and Dugas is fast approaching the delivery of a million metric tonnes of MTBE," the company said.
